audit.why: Garen 52.72% over 2627 games with the chart Garen-favoured through First item and Kassadin at 2+ items matches the real lane: Kassadin has no pre-6 kill pressure and outscales hard.
audit.corrected: Chart left as-is except the corrupted side token at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5].t states Riftwalk is a 6-second cooldown and frames the whole plan around waiting for it.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s per the kit — it is never a real punish window, and it shrinks as he ranks it. Advice built on a 6s window teaches the player to wait for something that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t and spikes[1].text around 5s at rank 1 / 2s at rank 3 and the stacking mana cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] claims his Q shield negates Garen's Q; spikes[0].text says the silence 'shuts off his Q shield'.
audit.why: Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage only — Decisive Strike and Judgment are physical, so the shield eats none of it. What the silence actually does is deny Null Sphere, which is his only interrupt. Also missing: Nether Blade (W) is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice actionable.

edits.before: Track Kassadin’s Riftwalk (6s): His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1 but only 2s at rank 3 — there is no cooldown window late. Kill him before Riftwalk ranks up.

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: His Nether Blade auto-reset wind-up is the tell — step out on it, not the cast.

edits.before: Kassadin is famously weak pre-6; your Q-silence shuts off his Q shield and spellcasting and E shreds him, so all-in every time your abilities are up.
edits.after: Kassadin is helpless pre-6: his Q shield absorbs only magic, so it eats none of your damage, and Decisive Strike's 8s silence denies Null Sphere entirely.

edits.before: His R Riftwalk arrives but you counter it with your own R execute, punish him before his blink stacks scale.
edits.after: Riftwalk lands at 6 on a 5s cooldown with stacking mana cost — force repeats, then Demacian Justice executes him.

edits.before: Use Q silence-block shield to negate your Q
edits.after: Land Null Sphere to interrupt and shield up
